scientific_integrity: Complete three-round EF argument for all dimensions at least 27 together with exhaustive exact logical-type census for dimensions 0 through 27; independently checked by concrete elementwise oracle for dimensions 0 through 5. No external independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the pure binary order/equality language and quantifier rank at most three are covered.
244-face representative bound is sharp only inside the cubical face-lattice family.
Finite type comparisons require replay of the accompanying standard-library Python program; the infinite tail is covered by a separate mathematical proof.
Possible overlap with unavailable or unindexed historical works cannot be ruled out.
title: Six rank-three theories of finite cubical face lattices
